examples.arabic: رجعت البيت تعبان بس قلبي كان مليان فرحة.
examples.english: I returned home tired but my heart was full of joy.
examples.transliteration: ragaat el beyt taaban bas alby kan malyan farha.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.arabic: الاستاد كان مليان ناس وصوت الجمهور كان عالي اوي
examples.english: The stadium was full of people and the crowd's sound was very loud.
examples.transliteration: El-estad kan malyan nas we sot el-gomhour kan 3ali awi.
examples.storyTitle: The Day of the Football Match

examples.arabic: البيت كان مليان زينة بالونات والوانها كانت مبهجة اوي
examples.english: The house was full of decorations and balloons, and their colors were very cheerful
examples.transliteration: El beit kan malyan zeina w balloonat w alwanha kanet mobhega awi

examples.english: Her house is always full of warmth and love.
examples.transliteration: Beitha dayman malyan def' we hob

examples.arabic: السوق كان مليان ناس وكل واحد بيفاصل على سعر الخضار والفاكهة
examples.english: The market was full of people and everyone was bargaining over the price of vegetables and fruits.
examples.transliteration: Es-souq kān malyān nās we koll wāḥed biyefāṣel ʿala seʿr el-khoḍār wel-fākha.
examples.storyTitle: A Trip to the Popular Market
